name: Loners
description: Independent stalkers seeking fortune and survival in the Zone. United only by their desire for freedom and profit.

name: Duty
description: Military faction dedicated to containing the Zone's horrors and protecting the outside world from its expansion.

name: Freedom
description: Anarchist fighters opposing authoritarian control over the Zone. They believe the Zone's secrets should be freely shared.

name: Ecologists
description: Research scientists studying the Zone's anomalous phenomena. They seek to understand and potentially harness the Zone's power.

name: Bandits
description: Criminals and outcasts who prey on other stalkers. They survive through robbery, extortion, and violence.

name: Military
description: Government forces tasked with containing the Zone and eliminating illegal stalkers. Well-equipped but struggling against Zone's dangers.

name: Monolith
description: Fanatical cult serving the Zone's consciousness. They guard the center with supernatural dedication and advanced technology.
